module origen_149906(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input ps2_clk,
    input ps2_data,
    output [9:0] data_out,
    output ready
);

reg [10:0] data_in;
reg [3:0] cnt;
reg key_expand;
reg key_break;
reg key_done;
reg [8:0] data;

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst) begin
    if (!rst) begin
        cnt <= 0;
        key_expand <= 0;
        key_break <= 0;
        key_done <= 0;
        data <= 0;
    end
    else begin
        if (ps2_clk == 1 && ps2_clk == $past(ps2_clk, 1)) begin
            data_in[cnt] <= ps2_data;
            cnt <= cnt + 1;

            if (cnt == 11) begin
                cnt <= 0;

                if (data_in == 11'h17E) begin
                    key_expand <= 1;
                end
                else if (data_in == 11'h17F) begin
                    key_break <= 1;
                end
                else begin
                    data <= {key_expand, key_break, data_in[8:1]};
                    key_done <= 1;
                end
            end
        end
        else begin
            key_done <= 0;
        end
    end
end

assign data_out = {key_expand, key_break, data};
assign ready = key_done;

endmodule
